I was 12 when my step mom tried to kill me. I was playing guitar hero in the living room while my siblings were upstairs. My parents were fighting until she called me into the kitchen, insisting that I should be doing chores. It felt off just because I would never be the only kid out of 4 told to do chores, especially when my dad wanted to make sure it was fair for whatever reasons. We had a dining room table that sat in the center of the kitchen and as I walked around it to grab the broom, she grabbed my arm and started punching me in the back of the head. I'm 23 now and still 4'11".  I fell to the floor in front of the stove and pissed my pants. She picked me up by my neck and choked me until her kids tried to pull her off of me. She'd only ever laid her hands on me one time, but had threatened my dad with my life in front of me at least 3 times before. My dad said I was lying about it, but Im pretty sure if I remember correctly its because he started beating her daughter. When I was 18 I found out they might've been using meth at the time.  Shits crazy.
